name: Holiday Heartbeat
source:
Liam has been secretly in love with his best friend Rayan for years. They are now roommates.

Busy with work and studies, they don't even spend time together. So, they go on vacation to the beach to catch up with the lost time.

This is the perfect time for Liam to confess!

But when unforeseen events arise on his way, will he succeed in declaring his flame?

[From [url=https://cleanne.itch.io/holiday-heartbeat]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
利亚姆暗恋死党拉扬已有多年，如今两人更是成了同居室友。

平时忙于工作与学业，他们甚至连好好相处的时间都没有。于是两人决定前往海滩度假，把错过的时光统统补回来。

对利亚姆而言，这正是表白心意的绝佳时机！

然而面对接踵而至的意外插曲，他究竟能否成功倾诉心中的炽热爱意？

[摘自[url=https://cleanne.itch.io/holiday-heartbeat]itch.io[/url]]
